summary: Pairly AI first iteration test. Backend pytest: 20/20 passed (one initial failure was a test-script casing bug — server lowercases emails — fixed in-place, no server bug). Frontend Playwright E2E on mobile viewport (390x844): signup with chef role → Pair tab, category chips visible, POST /api/pairings returned Claude-generated headline + 5 pairings + mini recipe on real LLM call, favorite toggle works and item appears in Saved tab, Menus tab built a real coursed menu via /api/menus, Profile → Premium banner opens Paywall → mock PayPal capture unlocks Pro and Pair tab pill flips to 'Pro'. Only failure was the sign-out step which coincided with a Metro websocket disconnect (1006) — likely a preview-server transient, not application logic.

issues: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' — non-blocking, likely emitted from a third-party RN component.

action_items: Optionally investigate the 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' console warning and migrate to style.pointerEvents where possible (cosmetic, not blocking).

Manually re-verify Sign-out on the deployed preview: the Playwright run hit a Metro websocket disconnect right at that step, so functional correctness of onSignOut → auth screen redirect was not conclusively observed (implementation looks correct in code).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores user_id in Mongo as a string (from str(ObjectId)) while querying pairings/menus by that string user_id — consistent and works, just noting it's stored as string not ObjectId which limits joins. Fine for current scope.
run_llm falls back openai/gpt-5.5 after anthropic failure — good resilience.
used_today() uses regex on created_at ISO string prefix — correct but relies on the created_at being stored ISO-UTC; matches current insertion. OK.
PayPal MOCK path returns is_premium true immediately, matches product decision (documented in memory/test_credentials.md).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_pairly_backend.py (new — 20 pytest cases covering auth, profile, usage, pairings CRUD+favorite+isolation, daily-limit via DB seed, menus, PayPal mock)
seed_data_creation: Auth tests idempotently create/login the two documented seed users chef@pairly.app and cook@pairly.app (both Pairly123!). Daily-limit test inserts 5 pairing docs directly into MongoDB for an isolated TEST_limit_* user, then cleans them up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints verified end-to-end including real LLM calls (Claude sonnet-4-6 primary; ~15-30s per request). If re-running backend tests, note that Claude calls consume LLM credits and each pairings/menus test triggers a real LLM invocation (~5 real LLM calls in the suite). Daily-limit test does NOT call LLM — it seeds Mongo and asserts 402. Preview URL is https://taste-blend-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Frontend web preview occasionally drops Metro websocket after long sessions; if selectors go stale mid-run, reload the page.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs. The single test-side failure (TestAuth.test_signup_and_me) was resolved by lowercasing the expected email in the assertion; backend intentionally normalises email to lowercase at signup (line 295 server.py).
